data.context: In the 2025 analytic note *Evaluating Trade Marks as a Leading Economic Indicator of the Australian Business Cycle*, the “About the study” section describes the study’s data and methods: quarterly Australian trade mark filings from Q1 1970 to Q2 2023, identified by earliest application date, were combined with 24 leading indicators and real GDP; business-cycle turning points came from the Melbourne Institute report using the Bry-Boschan Quarterly rule.
